prompt: In this repository, find the function that works out the filesystem directory of a module or package from its import name (it is used to locate an application's root path). Report the file and the line where that function is defined, as path:line.

You have not seen this codebase before. Describe the public API of the configuration object class in src/flask/config.py: list the name of every public method defined directly on that class (not dunder methods, not inherited ones), each with one sentence on what it does.

Bug report: Config.get_namespace(..., lowercase=True) returns keys in upper case, and lowercase=False lowercases them. Find the cause and fix it. The existing test suite in tests/test_config.py must pass.

Add a method get_bool(self, key, default=False) to flask's Config class. It returns the boolean value of config[key]: booleans are returned unchanged; the strings 'true', '1', 'yes', 'on' (any case) mean True; 'false', '0', 'no', 'off' and the empty string mean False; any other string raises ValueError. A missing key returns default. Change only src/flask/config.py.

Add a blinker signal named config_loaded to flask.signals (alongside the existing signals). Config.from_mapping must send it after it has stored the values, with sender set to the Config instance and a keyword argument keys holding the list of keys it stored, in the order they were stored. Keep the existing behaviour of from_mapping otherwise.
Rename the private helper _endpoint_from_view_func to _view_func_endpoint everywhere in the repository (definition, imports, call sites, tests, docs). Make no other change.
